name: Enemies in the Water
statusNote: New in Forever.  From Wowhead’s Forever database.
footerSourceNote: This quest is new in Forever: its text, givers, objectives and rewards come from Wowhead’s Forever database until the beta confirms them. Quest text © Blizzard Entertainment.

narrative.details:
champion, your arrival is timely. I have just received new reports of naga activity just off of our coast. They seem to be swarming around some old troll ruins near the ocean floor.

We are already stretched thin defending from the local Bloodscalp and ogres ransacking our caravans. We cannot afford a surprise attack from the sea.

Go and slay as many as you are able, and bring me their tridents as proof of your success.
narrative.objectives: Gather 10 Brinescale Tridents from Brinescale Skirmishers.
